children: Morgan Stanley urges Rio Tinto plc Sponsored ADR (LSE:RIO) to prioritize aluminum returns via AP60 ramp-up, Weipa moves and Matalco utilization as the company negotiates lower Oct–Dec premiums with Japanese buyers, posts stronger-than-expected dividends and issued new shares under its employee plan.
: Morgan Stanley advises Rio Tinto (RIO) to boost aluminum returns over volume growth, citing AP60 ramp-up, Weipa replacement/expansion and higher Matalco utilization as key value drivers.
: Rio Tinto (RIO) is negotiating Oct–Dec primary aluminium premiums with Japanese buyers. Initial offers near $310–$325/ton over LME, down about 18–22% from the prior quarter; talks ongoing.
: Rio Tinto plc Sponsored ADR (RIO) reported dividends about 13% above expectations in the recent earnings season follow-up, boosted by dividend reinstatements across Australian miners.
: Rio Tinto plc Sponsored ADR (RIO) issued 209 ordinary shares in August 2026 under its employee share plan. Total issued shares 1,256,050,913; voting rights 1,255,153,524. New shares trade on LSE.
